topic.title: Components Search
topic.shortdesc: Use the Components tab to search for reusable components within the entire project.

body.p: The Components tab within the Workspace Search view provides ways to search for reusable content in a project. It allows you to define folders with DITA topics that contain XML elements with IDs that can be reused. You can then insert content references to those reusable ID elements or open their definition location.
The Components tab contains the following options and features:

dlentry.dd: Use this field to define a sequence of folder paths that will be searched for reusable components. The returned number of reusable components is capped at 10k elements. Any change to the path is saved in the local browser storage.
Use this field to search for a component's ID or text to filter the components list.

Each found component in the resulting list presents the source file, element ID, and contained text. While hovering over a component result, additional actions become available in top-right corner of the result:
Open in editor - Opens the topic that contains the component in the visual editor.
Insert content reference - Inserts a content reference (or content key reference if a DITA key is defined) to the particular component in the current document.
